test_title: SSC Selection Post Graduation Level Official Paper (Held on: 14 March 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Who among the following got Padma Vibhushan Award 2022 under the Public Affairs category?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Kalyan Singh.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Padma Award** is one of the** highest civilian Awards in India** and is conferred in three categories i.e. Padma Vibhushan, Padma Bhushan, and Padma Shri.
 
• In 2022, the Padma award has been conferred to **128 people **by the President of India and has comprised **4 Padma Vibhushan, 17 Padma Bhushan, and 107 Padma Shri Awards.**
 
• **Kalyan Singh was a politician and the 16th Chief Minister of Uttar Pradesh.**

• Tokyo Olympic Gold medalist **Neeraj Chopra** **was honored with Padma Shri.**
 
• **Ghulam Nabi Azad** is an Indian politician of the Indian National Congress who was the seventh chief minister of Jammu and Kashmir from 2005 to 2008 and was the Minister of Health and Family Welfare. He served as the Leader of opposition in Rajya Sabha until 2021 February. He has been awarded Padma Bhushan 2022.
 
• **Natarajan Chandrasekaran** is chairman of Tata Sons. He was Chief operating officer and executive director of Tata Consultancy Services, where in 2009, he became Chief executive officer. He has been awarded Padma Bhushan 2022.
